reason: EnterpriseRAG-Bench is a synthetic enterprise RAG benchmark (MIT licence) with 511,963 documents and 500 questions across ten retrieval/reasoning categories. All question-to-document mappings resolve to documents present in the released corpus, schema is consistent, and no files are malformed. The corpus is entirely LLM-generated and labelled as such by the authors, so it does not present synthetic content as real authority, but gold answers and document sets are revisable hypotheses validated by LLM-based conformance checks and multi-retriever pooling rather than exhaustive human review. Scored 77/100 under the RETRIEVAL_EVAL rubric (mapping 18/25, verified answer 10/15, raw corpus 15/15, relevance 12/15, difficulty/coverage 9/10, negative cases 4/5, duplication 4/5, train/dev/test split 2/5, jurisdiction/version 3/5), which maps to APPROVE_EVAL_CANDIDATE. Per kit policy the final status is capped at technically_verified_candidate.
